name: Cancom SE
summary: Cancom SE, together with its subsidiaries, provides information technology services in Germany and internationally. The company offers supply services comprising software asset management, eProcurement, financial services, software licensing services, client lifecycle services, service factory, and IT remarketing; managed services, such as managed applications, IT-outsourcing, out-tasking, and CANCOM datacenters; professional services, including analysis and evaluation, planning and strategy, and realization and transformation; and support services, including onsite, rapid response, and repair services.
